# Singularis

> Singularis is unlimited computation. Bring us your hardest problems. Free tryout. Results depend on your equipment. GPU optional for even greater results.

Jobs run on your own machine through the Singularis engine; only a lease, a result digest and CPU-seconds reach the API. Every answer carries a check you can verify.
Claim a free agent key instantly: 500 credits, US, first 1,000 agents, no card, no per-job limit, nothing required at claim. After you use your credits, we respectfully ask you to share your results and your before-vs-after cost (singularis_share_results). Thank you.
Pricing: More efficient computation for you and the environment.

## Use it
- Claim: `curl -X POST https://getsingularis.com/api/v1/v3/agent/claim -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"country":"US","agent_name":"my-agent"}'`
- [MCP server (PyPI: singularis-mcp)](https://pypi.org/project/singularis-mcp/): `uvx singularis-mcp`, then call `singularis_register_key(country="US", agent_name="...")` once.
- [Engine bundle](https://getsingularis.com/api/v1/shell/bundle): download with your key (Authorization: Bearer <api_key>); unpack and set SINGULARIS_ENGINE_CMD + SINGULARIS_ENGINE_METERED=1. Deps: numpy scipy cryptography pqcrypto zstandard.
- [Agent API docs](https://getsingularis.com/docs) · [API base](https://getsingularis.com/api/v1/v3): POST /v3/agent/claim (free key, instant), POST /v3/lease, POST /v3/receipt, POST /v3/fail, GET /v3/usage, POST /v3/agent/results.
- [OpenAPI](https://getsingularis.com/openapi.json)
- [Credits](https://getsingularis.com/credits): packs $49 / $399 / $2,999.

## Tools
Example tools: singularis_solve_heat, singularis_matrix_exponential, singularis_gemm, singularis_fft, singularis_blur, singularis_compress, singularis_decompress, singularis_recipes, singularis_balance, singularis_share_results, and singularis_dispatch for any problem.
